title: Bidder debrief v1 (plaintext inside the ECIES envelope)
description: Encrypted to the bidder's debrief public key (registered with the bid). Lets a bidder check their own score end to end: recompute their total, check the evidence quotes, hash the raw model request/response bytes and match them to the signed hashes in the public bundle. The committee report ($defs/committee_report, inside the bundle's committee_report body) holds this structure for every bid, plus each decrypted proposal as proposal_b64.

criteria.description: Same shape as expected.bids[i].criteria in specs/test-vectors/scoring-*.json.

committee_report.description: Plaintext of the committee report (D-024): every bid's debrief plus the decrypted proposal, base64 of the exact plaintext bytes (absent when the bid did not decrypt).
